title: Vela
subtext: Part-time Founding Engineer · previously SWE Intern
details:
SWE Intern (Jun 2025–Aug 2026); Part-time Founding Engineer (Sep 2026–Present), working in person in San Francisco on weekends and remotely/hybrid after school.
Led SOC 2 and ISO security/compliance work plus internal company operations.
Designed Vela’s custom font, theme, brand language, animated icon system, landing pages, product motion, and core UI/UX for agent workflows.
Produced eight investor/public demo films using Three.js, custom interaction capture, technical visualization, and high-fidelity motion design.

title: AlphaStar Academy
details:
Teach advanced Python and USACO Bronze to gifted Bay Area students through the AlphaStar-Carina Scholarship Program.
Built and taught multiple course tracks, mentored students 1:1, monitored progress, and coordinated regularly with program supervisors.

title: Algoverse
details:
Conducted applied AI research on persistent memory and temporal reasoning for real-time visual perception systems.
Built vector-memory and dynamic relational-graph components for privacy-sensitive, resource-constrained environments.
Research paper available on OpenReview.

title: Mustang Math
subtext: Platform Developer for Math Tournament Tech Team
details:
Built tournament infrastructure for Mustang Math and contributed to COMPOSE, the shared problem-writing platform used with Stanford Math Tournament.
Shipped platform improvements with the tournament tech team supporting large national competitions.

title: Tulip Coaching
details:
Founded and taught project-based Python courses for middle school students.
Have run multiple courses for multiple students, from beginner programming fundamentals through more advanced follow-on material.

title: Let's Assist
details:
Built a volunteer-management platform used by 900+ students and community members.
Handles opportunity discovery, signups, attendance, service-hour verification, and school/organization workflows in one system.

title: Boy Scouts of America
details: Developed leadership skills and community service experience through active participation in troop activities. Completed numerous merit badges focused on outdoor skills, citizenship, and personal development. Participated in camping trips, service projects, and leadership training sessions.
